description: South West energy firm lights up next phase of growth with HSBC funding

headings.text: South West energy firm lights up next phase of growth with HSBC funding

The business will use an initial £5 million HSBC UK backed investment to deliver 10-to-20-year service contracts for projects across the UK, from Taunton to Edinburgh. These include replacing outdated fluorescent strip lighting with timed and sensor-controlled LEDs that can cut energy use by up to 85 per cent, alongside gas boiler replacements delivering energy savings of more than 30 per cent for landlords and tenants.
In addition, a further facility from HSBC UK will be available to support future contract delivery, and the business’s long term growth ambitions.
With the help of this funding, Boxed Solutions anticipates that the business’s turnover will double over the next twelve months, and this has already resulted in three new hires within the team.

Mike Button, Managing Director at Boxed Solutions, said: “Securing this partnership with HSBC UK is a landmark moment for our business. Having the bank’s backing gives us real credibility as we grow. The scalable nature of the funding matches our growth ambitions to bring energy efficient solutions to more homes across the UK. HSBC UK is now our business bank of choice, and we look forward to a long relationship.”

Chris Hill, Relationship Director at HSBC UK, added: “With housing providers increasingly under pressure to cut carbon and reduce energy bills, the need for practical retrofit solutions has never been greater. This deal gives Boxed Solutions the flexibility to invest in equipment and scale delivery across long-term contracts.”

Founded in 2012, Boxed Solutions delivers heating and lighting upgrades to ageing social housing developments with no upfront costs to landlords. Operating through long-term service contracts, the company helps housing providers cut energy use, reduce maintenance costs and improve living conditions through ultra-efficient boiler systems, remote building management technology and smart lighting upgrades.

HSBC UK serves over 15 million active customers across the UK, supported by over 23,000 colleagues. HSBC UK offers a complete range of retail banking and wealth management to personal and private banking customers, as well as commercial banking for small to medium businesses and large corporates. HSBC UK is a ring-fenced bank and wholly owned subsidiary of HSBC Holdings plc.

HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of HSBC, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 56 countries and territories. With assets of US$3,306bn at 31 March 2026, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations.
